cues: Second, the ligand changes the colour by changing delta o. Ammonia is higher than water in the spectrochemical series.
It splits the d orbitals more, the absorption shifts to higher energy, and the pale blue aqua complex becomes the deep royal blue ammine complex.
That is the cold open, solved.
